items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And there was Johnny, Elmer Williams on tenor, Bobby Stark on... Yeah, two brass. Bobby and Slats on trombone... I worked with Chick... That's when he was enlarging his band.

ctx.x: I mean, he was one of the top.

He was a good trumpeter. He was one of the good ones. And there was a lot of them, a lot of good ones. There was never no shortage of trying to find a good trumpeter. There was Bobby Stark, we had what's his name, who used to be with Fletcher, the fat....
